verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents Rules as manually defined constraints the agent follows, at both local and global levels. Rules can be set to Always On, Glob-scoped, Model Decision or Manual activation, which covers project-level coding standards. Rules can also be bundled in plugins, and SKILL.md files carry task-specific instructions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the project rules file format and location in the repo, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent reliably follows the rules.
